top20.why: Seeded 3-min gauntlet + friend link: same cards kill card-luck, Brier on a thumb slider, ladder gives mastery; best replay+social loop.
Health bar makes log loss legible: confident misses hurt, boss rooms give run tension and flow peaks; the true roguelike here.
Ranks only when your Brier band clears chance: skill, not a hot day, decides standing; mirrors TR-8 lower bound.
Known true odds score you on judgment, not outcome luck; belt ladder is a clean mastery curve. Ideal training mode.
Earn the right to say 90%: range caps lift as you prove calibration. Best-designed mastery gate in the set.
Ten rounds, one slider, a calibration dot per call, harder charts unlock: tight 2-3 min core loop.
Narrowing bridge turns sharpness-vs-coverage into a readable run with escalating stakes.
Daily seeded five-boss run with spoiler-free pip grid: shared ritual and conversation without a streak.
Week season = median of best five days: forgives a bad day, rewards consistent calibration, anti-tilt.
Tight-but-right cone feels like sniping; reveal sweep is a great payoff. Needs presets for one thumb.
Run-end report card (calibration, overconfidence count, one habit) gives the reason to run again.
75s daily 80% range puzzle, hit/miss grid: smallest session that still scores calibration honestly.
Native to the swipe feed: one-thumb, instant reveal, capped at three a day. Needs swipe-distance confidence.
Boss built from your own worst bias: adaptive difficulty that targets what you need to learn.
Interval Archer with a finite archive: catch-up without daily guilt; archive kept unranked.
Async range duel on one seed: narrower-and-right wins; score width and coverage jointly to stop always-wide.
Word-a-day chart puzzle with five-dot share grid and ghost: strongest daily social artifact.
Division promotion on Brier skill gives weekly stakes; cap rated rounds to stop grind.
90s: give probabilities, get a shareable reliability curve. The curve is the reward.
Same masked path for all, ranked on calibration with a 10-day minimum: fair field comparison.

judge_A_game_behavioural.clusters: 1) Seeded shared-card runs/duels (Gauntlet, Tape Reader, Showdown, Boss Rush) - best replay+social. 2) Roguelike health/bridge runs (Boss Gap, Narrow Bridge, Overconfidence Boss). 3) Slider calibration drills with ladders/curves (Confidence Ladder, Ladder of Doubt, Dojo, Mirror). 4) Range/cone interval games (Archer, Cone Catcher, Number Line, Twin Timeline). 5) Daily puzzles & crowd boards. 6) Seasons/leagues. 7) Bias/lesson/story niche (Echo, Anchor, Cycle, Morning Pages).
judge_A_game_behavioural.warning: Do not let one 10-card session decide a winner: card luck swamps calibration at n=10. Score on proper rules (Brier/log or joint width+coverage, never hit rate or paper P&L), show bands, rank only past a sample floor, and keep binary swipes from erasing confidence. Avoid daily streak pressure, multi-slider cards and free text on a phone.

top20.why: Range drill with a finite archive shelf: completion without a daily treadmill, keyboard-adjustable handles, coverage scoring is honest and explainable
Narrowing-bridge roguelike on synthetic paths: real fun, zero data licence cost, sharpness-vs-coverage made visible; no ranking needed
Synthetic paths with known true odds: the only design where 'good prediction' is measurable without noise; cheap, no signal risk
Interval Archer base: plain one-line explainer, ladder unlocks harder charts not score; strong ergonomic gesture
Seeded 3-min gauntlet shared by link: social without feeds or contact import; rate-limit invites, no global board
Run ends in a descriptive report card (calibration, overconfident count, one habit), weekly cadence: closure instead of 'one more run'
Boss built from your own past biases, kept on-device: personal replay variety, privacy-safe (P3), log scoring teaches humility
Seeded friend gauntlet plus descriptive habit tags; codex instead of rating keeps game far from verified records
Synthetic hidden drift teaches noise looks like trend; ascension modifiers neutral or harder, never extra score (no power creep)
Ten-round masked slider with a calibration dot each round; simplest honest core; must label paper-only, not trading skill
Weekly pass/fail mastery trials with retry, no ranking: progression without leaderboard anxiety or loss-chasing
Fictional confident opinions sway your slider; scoring rewards ignoring them: an anti-signal game that trains independence
Balanced synthetic draws expose up-bias with a neutral tilt meter; cheap, educational, no real securities
Boss gap rooms make tail risk memorable; health bar makes log loss legible; needs a calm run end, no instant retry prompt
Cone catcher with anchor decoy revealed afterwards: tactile and teaches a bias; needs keyboard/preset handles for A1
Seeded synthetic range duel scoring width and coverage jointly; synthetic avoids licensing and any read as a real call
Over-extrapolation drill with a bias readout about your forecasts only; counters chasing momentum, fits slider
Volatility-up probability on labelled synthetic paths; teaches clustering without direction calls (less signal-like)
Earned probability range (40-60% first, extremes later) is a clever honest progression; swap swipe for a slider
Friend league votes on synthetic world rules: social governance fun, labelled simulated, no global rank

judge_B_safety_legal_engineering.clusters: 1) Range/interval drills (Interval Archer, Sweet Spot, Cone, Bridge, Twin Timeline): best gesture, honest scoring. 2) Probability-slider calibration drills on synthetic or masked paths (Dojo, Blind Drift, Confidence Ladder, Mirror). 3) Seeded async challenges by link (Gauntlet, Tape Reader). 4) Daily shared-seed boards and share grids (Crowd vs You, Mystery Month, Jury). 5) Seasons/leagues/divisions. 6) Bias-exposure games (anchor decoy, echo chamber, tilt, bias boss). 7) Binary swipe rounds (Fog of Candles). 8) Story/journaling with free text.
judge_B_safety_legal_engineering.warning: Don't let 'replayable' slide into compulsion: daily share grids, global boards, promotion/relegation, unlimited unrated runs and 60-second timers each rebuild streaks or slot loops. Prefer synthetic data (no licence cost, no real-security read). Keep game scores off profiles and feed, never call them skill, and give every drag or swipe a keyboard and screen-reader path.
